annotations.title: Store wallets this key may spend from

description: Store the 0x wallets this sg_live_ key is allowed to spend from. Call it when an operator names those wallets, once, not on every spend, and not to approve a payment. score_spend still has to run before any transfer. A block or ask_human from score_spend means do not broadcast. Pass allowed_wallets. This replaces the stored list for that key in one write. An empty array stores an allowlist that authorizes no wallet, so a later score with from_wallet and no call-level list returns block, reason unauthorized_wallet. allowed_wallets is required. At most 32 addresses. A published developer test account (Hardhat/Anvil default accounts, Ganache, BIP-39 test, and other public test mnemonics) is rejected with dev_wallet and is not stored. Requires api_key, or Authorization: Bearer sg_live_. Anonymous and bundle callers cannot store a list; they can pass allowed_wallets on score_spend instead. An unrecognized key returns invalid_api_key. A missing key returns api_key_required. Does not consume a score and is never billed. Returns key_id, key_prefix, allowed_wallets, and updated_at. A new key starts with no list, which makes a later from_wallet ask_human with reason wallet_unverified until you set one. Do not put a private key or a recovery phrase in this tool. Addresses only.

allowed_wallets.description: 0x addresses this key may spend from. Replaces the stored list. An empty array authorizes none. Public developer test accounts are rejected and not stored.

api_key.description: sg_live_ key this list belongs to. You can also send Authorization: Bearer. Required. Anonymous callers cannot store a list.
